description: Liv.rent helps users search residential rental listings through ChatGPT. Users can ask for apartments, condos, houses, townhomes, or rooms by location, price, bedroom and bathroom count, pet policy, furnishing, availability, lease type, rental type, verification status, and size, then view matching listings, photos, prices, and map results in a read-only widget.
